subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to the two people at the stall

745100101.text: We won! Our Fungi companions did it!

745100102.text: Hats off to you, you two!

745100103.text: Your taming talents are beyond common sense, and the Fungi remain undefeated under your command even when facing enemies that themselves defy reason!

745100106.text: Paimon remembers seeing the Great Snowboar King and Maguu Kenki before, but this time, you even brought out a "Blade Pup."

745100107.text: You really went all out when you set that lineup, huh?

745100108.text: Well, these enemies are all legends in adventurers' stories from all over the world! Our players will definitely resonate with them.

745100109.text: As a writer, I'm a huge fan of characters from different works battling one another. I get excited just thinking about it!

745100110.text: Anyway, dear Twin Stars of Brilliant Valor, you've played every stage of our game. What do you think?
